reasons: Datadog groups by docker_image, but the candidate's avg() has no by-clause, so all containers and devices collapse into one series.
The correct grouping label in the dataset is container_image_name (observed), so the PromQL should be avg by (container_image_name)(rate(...)).
The rate() over a monotonic sum with $__rate_interval is acceptable, and the operation="read" filter matches the read-bytes intent.
The scope template variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.
The candidate's series count (one aggregate series versus one per image) therefore differs from the Datadog request.
